title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Caregiver
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Caregiver. The class of caregivers (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor; inherits firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan and hasActivity from HealthActor (see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthActor/schema.json), in addition to its own hasPatient property declared below.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Caregiver'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasPatient.description: Relationship. A caregiver may have one or multiple patients. ttl-confirmed, domain Caregiver, range Patient (s4ehaw:hasPatient). Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Patient'. May also be an array of URIs when a caregiver has more than one patient.
